activity_summary: Nick would not weep at the margin. He can weep, and he will not do it before the scene gives him cause. On Thursday the cause came three lines later. You explained why the tears should come first, and you heard the explanation fail halfway, when you reached a night that is not on the roll. Augustine had him give it plain. It was less to look at and more to believe. Richard forgot to fidget. You struck the direction out with a paring-knife, and you left the boy as he was. The jaw made every consonant a negotiation.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Heard himself leave the roll, struck the direction out, and said the boy knew better.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Refused to weep before the cause, and gave the scene plain.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Asked to hear it without the margin, and kept the boy unchanged.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Forgot to fidget, and kept his cue where it was.
